description: Phase 03 of the books pipeline — upsert validated MDX corpus into Supabase via Drizzle. Hydrates `books`, `book_chapters`, `book_sections`, and `book_chunks` tables. Maintains separation between display sections (stable bookmark anchors) and RAG chunks (regenerable retrieval units) so re-embedding never invalidates user bookmarks. Idempotent — only re-sections / re-embeds chapters whose `content_sha256` changed. Use after `/book-frontmatter` passes Zod validation. Trigger phrases: "ingest into supabase", "upsert the book", "phase 03", "load the corpus into the database".
